result.summary: Found 1 visually broken element: an invalid '€NaN delivery' price displayed on the Smash Bros Burgers restaurant card.

issues.description: The 'Smash Bros Burgers' card under 'Fastest near you' displays '€NaN delivery' instead of a valid delivery fee.
issues.suggestion: Fix delivery fee formatting / data handling to prevent NaN from rendering; show the correct price or a fallback such as hiding the fee when unavailable.
